g.title: FEED
g.text: 3 x 400 V + N + PE, 63 A per phase

g.title: BOARD
g.text: main switch 63 A 4 pole, one 3 phase breaker per branch
branches - pod A 32 A, pod B 32 A, rack PDU 32 A, cooling (not sized)

g.title: W_RA
g.text: 32 A breaker, 19.6 A per phase at most

g.title: W_RB
g.text: 32 A breaker, 19.6 A per phase at most

g.title: W_PDU
g.text: 32 A breaker, load not known yet

g.title: RECT_A
g.text: 230 V modules in multiples of 3, one third per phase
13.5 kW in, 12.8 kW out at most; 19.6 A per phase; GND earthed here

g.title: W_DCA
g.text: about 270 A at 48 V; shorter is better, or bolt the shelf to the bar

g.title: RECT_B
g.text: 230 V modules in multiples of 3, one third per phase
13.5 kW in, 12.8 kW out at most; 19.6 A per phase; GND earthed here

g.title: W_DCB
g.text: about 270 A at 48 V; shorter is better, or bolt the shelf to the bar

g.title: PDU
g.text: 3 phase, 32 A, outlets grouped per phase
3 GPU nodes, 4 storage nodes, switches; loads not known yet

g.title: BUS_A
g.text: bar with 6 block breakers of 63 A DC
each breaker feeds one block (cabling/block-power.yml, PSU and Q1)

g.title: BUS_B
g.text: bar with 6 block breakers of 63 A DC
each breaker feeds one block (cabling/block-power.yml, PSU and Q1)
